title: Fire & Smoke Mitigation Cashiering Quick Reference: Card Surcharge, Dispute Window, Goodwill Cap and Refund Timing
content:
Quick reference for the Fire & Smoke Mitigation account figures the cashiering and customer desks read most: the credit card surcharge, the dispute window for billing corrections, the goodwill credit cap and the refund processing time.

## Figures defined

- Credit card surcharge: Surcharge on payments made by credit card (never debit card, ACH or check), percent.
- Dispute window: Days after the final invoice date within which a billing-error or duplicate-line dispute may be credited, calendar days.
- Goodwill credit cap: Maximum total goodwill credit the desk may post on one job, USD.
- Refund processing time: Business days (Monday-Friday excluding company holidays) to issue an overpayment refund after it is approved, count.

## By tier

| Tier | Credit card surcharge | Dispute window (calendar days) | Goodwill credit cap per job (USD) | Refund processing (business days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Smoke Odor Response | 2.95 percent | 60 | 100.00 | 10 |
| Light Smoke and Soot Cleanup | 2.95 percent | 60 | 150.00 | 10 |
| Moderate Fire and Smoke Cleanup | 2.95 percent | 60 | 200.00 | 10 |
| Heavy Fire Cleanup | 2.95 percent | 60 | 300.00 | 10 |
| Structural Fire Large Loss | 2.95 percent | 60 | 400.00 | 10 |
| Commercial Fire Large Loss | 2.95 percent | 60 | 500.00 | 10 |

## Points to note

- Only the goodwill credit cap varies by tier, from 100.00 to 500.00 per job; the surcharge of 2.95 percent, the 60-day dispute window and the 10 business days for refunds are the same on all six tiers.
- The goodwill cap is a total for the whole job, not a figure per credit.
- Business days run Monday to Friday and exclude company holidays.
